messages:
sophia-finance: Heads-up — customer Odysseus flagged a large embed spike on their APAC invoice for 2026-03-02. They claim ~1.1M duplicate embeds. Can eng/data confirm and advise if we should issue a provisional credit?

kevin-eng: thanks. can you paste the customer org_id and a sample request id or CSV? I can run a recount.

julia-cs: org_id is odysseus-prod. I uploaded their CSV to the secure drive and sent the link to your inbox @kevin-eng. customer is asking for a credit while we sort it. :eyes:  

oliver-data: quick recount on embed_events for odysseus-prod in APAC between 2026-03-02T02:00 and 2026-03-02T05:00 UTC. ran a GROUP BY request_id and compared distinct counts.

oliver-data: ```sql
SELECT request_id, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM embed_events
WHERE org_id = 'odysseus-prod'
  AND region = 'apac'
  AND ts >= '2026-03-02 02:00:00'
  AND ts <  '2026-03-02 05:00:00'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

oliver-data: sample (anonymized): request_id abc123 -> cnt 4, def456 -> cnt 3, ghi789 -> cnt 3. estimated duplicate rows across window: ~1,078,432 extra embed events (sum(cnt)-distinct_count).

kevin-eng: checked apac-proxy logs — we saw a burst of 502/503s causing client retries. snippet: 

kevin-eng: ```
[2026-03-02T02:12:03Z] apac-proxy-2 upstream_status=502 request_id=abc123 attempt=1 ack=true
[2026-03-02T02:12:04Z] apac-proxy-2 upstream_status=200 request_id=abc123 attempt=2 ack=true
```

kevin-eng: root cause: proxy returned error after backend ack; client retried and we ingested duplicate events because dedupe happens later in the pipeline.

deploy-bot: region-proxy alert — apac-proxy-2 had elevated 502/503 between 2026-03-02T02:10 and 2026-03-02T03:08 UTC. queued_requests peak=123456.

julia-cs: customer is pushing for quick resolution; they shared their invoice and want a pro-rated fix if counts don’t reconcile.

sophia-finance: proposed approach: 1) issue provisional credit for estimated duplicates, 2) eng/data run dedupe + replay to produce canonical counts, 3) true-up in next invoice (refund or charge). propose provisional $1,200 to be safe. opinions?

kevin-eng: we can dedupe on request_id+ack_id and reprocess. risk: legit retries where backend never saw first attempt could be lost. logs indicate most are proxy-retry cases. our estimate: net duplicates ≈ 1.05M embeds -> ~$1,146. provisional $1,200 is fine.

billing-bot: Created ticket FIN-2345 with provisional credit $1,200 for odysseus-prod period=2026-03-02 reason="apac-proxy duplicate ingest". Status: pending-approval.

sophia-finance: I approve provisional credit and notified customer that were investigating and will reconcile. Julia to handle CS comms.

julia-cs: sent customer message: "We've issued a provisional credit while we run a full recount and replay; we'll follow up with final numbers by EOD Friday." customer replied :thumbsup:.

oliver-data: starting the full dedupe+replay job now. ETA ~4h. I'll post final distinct counts and reconciliation summary when done.

sophia-finance: thanks all — keep this thread updated. once oliver posts final numbers we'll finalize the credit or invoice the delta. :handshake:
